quarterly_data.quarter: Winbond Electronics press release: Winbond to Acquire 100% Equity Interest in Infineon's NOR (09-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Acquisition: Winbond entered into a stock purchase agreement with Infineon Technologies LLC, a subsidiary of Infineon, to acquire 100% of the equity interest in Infineon's NOR Flash and F-RAM business (all-cash). The business is headquartered in San Jose, California, with over 30 years of experience in memory solutions; upon closing it will be named Spansion and will operate as a standalone entity with its headquarters in the United States. Winbond says the transaction is expected to expand its global R&D resources and enhance supply capabilities and services to global customers, bringing over talents from more than 10 countries with additional supply chain partners. Closing is expected in the second half of calendar year 2027, subject to closing conditions including required regulatory approvals.
